clause_answers.note: Clause-answer faithfulness checks that every number, identifier and clause reference in the answer appears in the retrieved chunks. The pipeline is retrieval-only (no generative clause answering), so the answer evaluated here is extractive (the retrieved chunk text itself) and is grounded by construction - this figure is reported for completeness and is partly circular.
